_help: Edit this file to create channels. Each channel: name, description, color (#hex), mode ('loop' = videos repeat in order all day from 'start', or 'fixed' = each item appears at its 'time'). Each item: 'id' = archive.org identifier of a single VIDEO (not a collection — collections like 'g4-xplay' are folders; use the episode identifiers inside them, e.g. 'X-Play.2011.04.19'). Watch out for brackets: every { needs a matching }, and channels are separated by commas.
_timezone_help: Set this to "utc" when you share the site: then every visitor worldwide sees the same broadcast clock. Keep "local" while only you watch. Add "timezone": "utc" inside a single channel to override just that channel.
_owner_help: Put a secret word here (e.g. "ownerPassword": "tvdinner") and the 'New channel' button locks: only someone who knows it can open the builder. Visitors can only watch. The true protection for a public site comes from hosting: keep channels.json in a place only you can edit (see README).
